# DS HAIR

> B2B wholesale hair sourcing, sample coordination and private-label development for hair brands, distributors, salons and professional buyers.

DS HAIR is the unified brand mark. WigExporter is its global B2B wholesale and OEM website. It is an inquiry-led sourcing website, not a consumer ecommerce store. Product availability, minimum quantities, prices and lead times are confirmed against a written specification.

## Canonical website

- https://wigexporter.com/

## Collections

- [Human hair extensions](https://wigexporter.com/human-hair-extensions.html): clip-ins, tape hair, K-tips and hair wefts
- [Genius Weft human hair extensions DS-EXT-GW](https://wigexporter.com/genius-weft-human-hair-extensions.html): 22 inch / 50 g blonde product reference for B2B specification review

## Product development system

- [DS HAIR Colour Chart 2 and Custom Packaging Studio](https://wigexporter.com/hair-colour-chart-custom-packaging.html) contains 31 individual digital shade references, a 31-shade range view, physical swatch references, private-label packaging structures and logo-application directions. Screen colour is for shortlisting; physical colour or representative product-sample approval is required before scale.
- Product pages allow buyers to request length, pack weight, texture, colour and packaging direction. A selection is an enquiry requirement, not a live-stock guarantee.
- The documented Genius Weft reference is 22 inch / 50 g / Straight. Other lengths from 16 to 28 inches, 100 g packs and wave or curl textures require written feasibility and sample confirmation.
- [Private label and custom packaging](https://wigexporter.com/customization.html#custom-packaging): labels, backing cards, care cards, inner protection, retail boxes and export identification are developed against a packaging brief.
- [Human hair wigs and toppers](https://wigexporter.com/human-hair-wigs-toppers.html)
- [Synthetic wigs and hairpieces](https://wigexporter.com/synthetic-wigs-hairpieces.html)
- [Clip-In Chignon synthetic hairpiece DS-HPC-SY-001](https://wigexporter.com/synthetic-clip-in-chignon-hairpiece.html): softly waved claw-clip chignon reference for B2B wholesale, OEM specification and private-label enquiry
- [22-Inch Straight Clip-In synthetic hairpiece DS-HPC-SY-002](https://wigexporter.com/synthetic-22-inch-straight-clip-in-hairpiece.html): one-piece seven-clip synthetic hairpiece reference for B2B wholesale, OEM specification and private-label enquiry
- [21-Inch Soft Curls Claw Clip synthetic ponytail DS-HPC-SY-003](https://wigexporter.com/synthetic-21-inch-soft-curls-claw-clip-ponytail.html): long soft-curl claw-clip ponytail reference for B2B wholesale, OEM specification and private-label enquiry
- [21-Inch Straight Claw Clip synthetic ponytail DS-HPC-SY-004](https://wigexporter.com/synthetic-21-inch-straight-claw-clip-ponytail.html): sleek straight claw-clip ponytail reference for B2B wholesale, OEM specification and private-label enquiry
- [Hair extension salon supplies](https://wigexporter.com/salon-supplies.html)
